reviews.title: too much crashes
reviews.text: this used to be my favorite app to listen to quran daily, but as of the last few months it continuously crashes when i open it, also when im playing a surah it crashes after only a few minutes. my phone is fairly new so i don’t know what the problem is. but this app has become useless.
